hypothesis: A fresh completed-15m breakout with exact pre-close L2 pressure may produce repeatable after-cost SP500 edge in both directions under the v51 execution and exit contract.
decision: Retain the live SP500 v3 route and frozen 100/40/80 profit-lock contract unchanged. The first exact short closed profitably after costs, but one short-only lifecycle is insufficient to infer repeatability, bidirectional edge, or a superior exit policy.

route_contract.entry_source: fresh completed-bar breakout onset plus receipt-causal pre-close depth-10 pressure
route_contract.opposite_exit: selected eligible opposite intent from the executable same-symbol route closes without same-cycle reversal

resolved_short_lifecycle.interpretation: The frozen timer produced a small after-cost win and exited before a five-minute reversal against the original short. This is descriptive evidence from one lifecycle, not proof that the timer or route has positive expected value.

exit_policy_assessment.reason: The lifecycle MFE was 15.8 bps, below every tested activation threshold, so no tested profit lock would have changed this exit.
exit_policy_assessment.reopen_rule: Require a newly preregistered causal policy and compatible exact venue evidence that passes development, untouched forward validation, realistic costs, and largest-winner removal.

limitations: Only one exact v51 SP500 lifecycle has resolved.
The only exact lifecycle is short; no exact long onset or lifecycle has occurred.
One profitable lifecycle cannot distinguish route edge from normal variance or establish profit factor robustness.
The entire observed net is the largest winner because the sample contains one trade.
Canonical regime context is unavailable for this HIP-3 route.
The five-minute post-exit reversal is descriptive and cannot establish timer superiority without independent compatible outcomes.
The historical lock study uses causal L2 midpoint rather than exact venue trade and mark paths.

decision_detail.recommendation: Continue exact source-native SP500 v3 live evidence collection under the unchanged v51 route and exit contract.
decision_detail.why_now: The first exact short is resolved and profitable after costs, closing the technical lifecycle gap but leaving direction coverage and repeatability unresolved.
decision_detail.evidence_reviewed: Immutable lifecycle-close audit, superseded open-lifecycle revision, and prior rejected SP500 lower-profit-lock study.
decision_detail.observed_problem_or_opportunity: The short route demonstrated executable positive net once, while the absent long sample and single-winner dependence prevent an economic conclusion.
decision_detail.applicable_market_regime: Fresh completed-15m breakout onset with receipt-causal pre-close L2 pressure; canonical regime context remains unavailable.
decision_detail.alternatives_considered: Change the timer, install a lower profit lock, tighten entry pressure, disable the route, or retain the frozen contract while collecting both sides.
decision_detail.expected_upside: Obtains source-compatible both-side economics without contaminating the experiment through post-hoc tuning.
decision_detail.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Sparse signals, one-sided sampling, ordinary variance, future execution degradation, source mismatch, and loss concentration can invalidate an apparent edge.
decision_detail.validation_completed: Exact route identity, entry pressure, entry and exit fills, fees, funding, slippage, stop ownership, completed holding path, timer decision, ignored provider exits, and five-minute post-exit path are reconciled.
decision_detail.validation_still_required: First exact long lifecycle, additional independent short lifecycles, compatible both-side after-cost outcomes, largest-winner sensitivity, and missed-opportunity review across a preregistered window.
decision_detail.success_metrics: Attributable both-side lifecycles, positive after-cost net and profit factor after largest-winner removal, zero routing gaps, and no single lifecycle contributing more than half of net.
decision_detail.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Lost stop protection, unaccounted route action, source mismatch, repeated after-cost losses, persistent one-sided inability to evaluate the configured contract, or new preregistered evidence falsifying the route or exit policy.
decision_detail.confidence_level: High confidence in lifecycle attribution; low confidence in route profitability.

minimum_evidence_to_update_diagnosis: Capture the first attributable eligible SP500 long and its fully resolved lifecycle; additional independent short outcomes remain necessary because one short is not repeatability evidence.
minimum_evidence_for_change_proposal: Use a preregistered compatible window with at least ten resolved lifecycles and at least three per side, exact fees, funding, slippage, latency, stop behavior, missed-opportunity review, positive net and profit factor after largest-winner removal, no lifecycle contributing more than half of net, and untouched forward confirmation. This is a review minimum, not statistical proof.

evidence.role: immutable exact-profile audit resolving the first source-native v51 SP500 lifecycle
prior rejected SP500 lower-profit-lock decision retained as negative prior art

falsifier: Revise this assessment if exact long evidence, additional source-native lifecycles, execution degradation, source mismatch, or a preregistered compatible exit study materially changes the after-cost and largest-winner-sensitive result.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Capture the first attributable eligible and fully resolved SP500 long under the unchanged v51 contract, while continuing to record additional independent short outcomes; do not retune from this single profitable short.
